scope: Synthetic generator labels only; actual PostgreSQL/controller path; no model replacement or activation

design.threshold_selection: Maximize additional synthetic positives on calibration at <=1% additional false positives; freeze before test

proposals.score_only_2fa: Only approved -> 2FA; no score, own-risk or rejection changes
proposals.corroborated_2fa: Same, with amount >= no_history_min_amount and at least two rapid repass pairs

limitations: Same artificial generator family as training; new seeds/dates are not independent real-world validation
Chronological receipt simulation, no full feedback loop after hypothetical graph interventions
Intervals are nominal binomial estimates; paired scenarios and seeds are not independent observations
Synthetic class prevalence does not estimate precision or losses in real Pix traffic
Entity-risk contribution disabled; the evaluated baseline is rules plus own account history

decision.reason: No candidate passes every numerical gate
